variants.name: Крупный пиксель
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: full battlefield art-direction study for an isometric fantasy tactics game, landscape 1536x1024.
Input roles: Image 1 is the MAIN composition and terrain reference (grass, blue streams, right-side sand and front gray stone). Image 2 is a secondary reference for the clean stepped tiles, simple scenery and deep plum background. Images 3, 4 and 5 are official identity reference portraits for Sir Gerald Lightseeker, Alleria Swiftwind and Magnus Spellbane from Kingdom Rush; use their CHARACTER designs only, never the circular badges, lettering or portrait crops.
Primary request: Reimagine the full battlefield in image 1 with those three Kingdom Rush heroes and three Kingdom Rush enemies as small complete game characters standing on the board. Render a single coherent finished scene, not a contact sheet.
Composition invariants: Preserve the floating diamond-shaped square-tile battlefield, isometric camera, overall tile count and generous empty spaces, blue branching stream layout, grass/sand/gray-stone arrangement and plain deep plum background. Keep board fully in frame, no cropping, same approximate framing as image 1. Preserve exactly six character placements: Gerald the paladin at the left-middle knight's location; Alleria the archer at the upper-left archer's location; Magnus at the lower-left purple character's location; a large green helmeted axe orc at upper right; one small green goblin at middle right and one at lower right. The three heroes face diagonally right toward enemies; the enemies face diagonally left. Feet grounded on single tiles with small contact shadows. Characters can be about 20-30 percent larger than in image 1 to show their designs, but remain tactical units about one to one-and-a-half tile-face heights, never giant portraits.
Identity: Gerald has silver chunky plate armor, vivid blue plume and cape, gold hilt and sword plus shield; Alleria has golden-blonde high ponytail, pointed elf ears, green cape and ranger tunic, brown bow and arrow quiver; Magnus has upright dark hair, dark goatee, purple robes with high cream-and-gold collar and purple gem, gold staff with violet orb (NO wizard hat, NO white beard). The orc has broad green muscular body, iron helmet, brown/iron armor and one axe. Goblins have green skin, huge pointed ears, small wiry brown-clothed bodies, tiny blades. Adapt likeness faithfully from the portraits to complete readable game sprites.
Constraints: coherent lighting and line treatment across all units; all silhouettes distinct at game scale; weapons readable; no added characters, no UI, no health bars, no numbers, no text, no logos, no badges, no watermarks, no split panels, no label. Keep terrain simple and secondary to character design.
STYLE 1 / CHUNKY PIXEL CLOSE TO THE USER REFERENCES: deliberately low-resolution clean pixel-art sprites, roughly a 32-40 pixel source-height character enlarged with hard nearest-neighbor edges. Chunky dark-purple 1-pixel source contours, compact sturdy chibi anatomy with big heads, clean broad color clusters and only 3 shades per material. Preserve square stepped pixel edges on terrain and characters; NO smooth antialiasing, NO painted texture, NO dithering, NO blur. Muted grass, ochre sand, cornflower water; bright blue/green/purple hero accents. The result should look like the user's reference evolved with recognizable Kingdom Rush characters.
